records.evidence: A token's inside holds no brace by the scan's own stop condition, so the bytes from end - 2 up to end + 1 are content bytes and the closing pair, none of which is an opening brace followed by another; end >= start + 1 = at + 3 makes end - 2 >= at + 1, so the position still advances and the loop ends. The rescanned positions find no opening pair, so the found list and the config_tokens set are identical for every input.

records.evidence: end == start means the text holds an opening pair straight followed by a closing pair; the empty slice found is refused by normalise (its first test is is_empty, giving None) before config_tokens collects, and the jump to end + 2 passes only the second opening brace and the two closing braces, none of which can start an opening pair because the byte after each is a closing brace or the next iteration's own start.
